Purpose: price plan 089/01's dynamic particle lane at its probe worst case. The probe (?fxprobe=prt_collisionsmoke) bursts 1 particle per fixed step (60/s, life 5 s => ~300 live), which at the player's feet fills roughly a third of the 1440x900 viewport with overlapping 2-8 m billboards — worst-case FILL, far denser than any single gameplay effect will be. CPU side is invisible at this scale: pool spawn+prune is array writes, the per-frame upload is one partial writeBuffer of ~10.8 KB (300 x 36 B) on the blend half only. The GPU delta is overdraw-bound: it scales with screen coverage of the plume, not with the particle count.
